description: Defines a custom JTable subclass for displaying and interacting with parameter lists in the RomRaider ECU tuning software, including custom cell rendering, editing, and tooltips.

classes.name: ParameterListTable
classes.description: A specialized JTable for displaying ECU parameter data with custom rendering, editing, and tooltips.

methods.name: ParameterListTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table with a specific table model, setting header properties, and column sortability.

methods.name: getCellRenderer
methods.description: Returns the appropriate cell renderer, using a combo box renderer for certain data types.

methods.name: getCellEditor
methods.description: Returns the appropriate cell editor, using a combo box editor for certain data types.

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.description: Provides a tooltip based on the parameter row description, if available.

methods.name: displayComboBox
methods.description: Determines if a combo box should be displayed for a cell based on its data type and convertors.

methods.name: setColumnSortable
methods.description: Sets whether a specific column is sortable.
